title: Nanha Mera Asghar Kaha Gaya
body:
Dhal Gaya Suraj Shamma Jali
<<MINI>>
nanha Mera Asghar Kaha Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
bano Pukari Kook Jali
<<MINI>>
nanha Mera Asghar Kaha Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Waqt E Madad Hai Mushkil Kusha
mushkil Karo Hal Behre Khuda
tum Hee Batado Moula Ali
<<MINI>>
nanha Mera Asghar Kaha Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Teri Zameen Par Aye Karbala
gum Hogaya Hai Bacha Mera
dhundhe Kaha Ye Maa Diljali
<<MINI>>
nanha Mera Asghar Kaha Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
3.tu Hee Bata De Aye Hurmula
cheda Hai Kyu Tune Nanha Gala
doobi Hai Khoon Me Nanhi Kali
<<MINI>>
nanha Mera Asghar Kaha Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Raat Andheri Sunsaan Ban
dhundhu Kaha Tujhe Ghunchadahan
roro Pukari Madar Yehi
<<MINI>>
nanha Mera Asghar Kaha Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jungle Me Kis Jaa Tu Khogaya
jhula Hai Khali Aye Mailaqa
kis Ko Jhulaye Maa Ab Teri
<<MINI>>
nanha Mera Asghar Kaha Gaya
